line.comment: * Task 0.
* [THIS] will go to $target sector before entering the main loop, even if $follow is set to [FALSE].
* OWP and Drones are ignored.
* Preliminary checks.
* Herobetty 5.3: If the owner is ownerless (neutral race), the ship will not attack. Shouldn't be doing this in vanilla either.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Clean up M7M logic. Move missile checker here.
* M7M and M8 are dedicated missile attackers.
* Other ships may also have missile turrets.
* Scan for ammunition.
* Dedicated M7M/M8 missile combat is used while usable ammunition is available.
* Mordan9 - TS ships in a fleet are support roles for carrying missiles or jump beacons. They should avoid combat.
* squadron leaders perform a retreat check whenever they engage something
* Mordan - add back OWP firing.
* This exits combat for turret-only ships by interrupting (halting) that stationTactics script.
* Already attacking this target? if so just return.
* If ordered to attack something that isn't a ship or a station, just return.
* Add-Ons 2.2: An unarmed ship may still direct fleet ships or active support ships homebased to it.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Cleaned up missile boat logic.
* Dedicated missile ships cannot attack without missile ammunition.
* Unarmed ships require usable missiles or combat subordinates.
* Move to the target system unless the target either stops existing, or someone captures it.
* AI M7Ms with ammunition prefer huge ships, then nearby stations.
* Zero Hour Merc Safety
* True attack begins here.
* Player carriers. If they have idle ships onboard, we make them support ships. Same code in !ship.signal.attacked.
* Update pilot skills.
* Get some fixed data.
* Returns the range of the ship's main laser battery; may return 0 if none exists.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Ships without main battery have no weapons. Fix this by checking if main laser range is greater than 0.
* Also, if a main battery exists, constrain engagement range to its shortest installed gun.
* sets max laser range to 90% actual, so that we get closer to the target.
* Defaults to 95 in 9972 t-file and says "the attacker will fire only below this value" ? Says all ships except M7M and M8
* Make sure we are enemies.
* Moves us 'above' the target. Does not engage or fire anything.
* Main loop.

* Add-Ons 1.4.11: Attempt to fix a rare bug where a docked target will freeze the game! Change should actually be in !plugin.gz.missile.def.mk3. Commented out as freeze was still there even after attempt.
* do if $target-> is docked
* break
* === This script should never be reset. ===
* Moveable ships don't wait.
* Go near the target.
* MordanA - Stop using station tactics script for the player ship. It forces the ship to orbit around the target, and if you try to stop
* yourself, the dam script keeps you moving around. It really interferes often with your ability to pilot the ship into a position you want.
* This is for a ship with Primary Front Turrets. (max laser strength in turret 0 is > 0)
* Mordan2. use get distance command instead of turret range command.
* "is $target in firing range of turret 0" will not work. This script has been overridden with a hack in InFiringRangeOfTurret.xml to allow for extending weapons ranges beyond
* the built-in X3 10k turret range limit. It was intended to allow turrets to shoot at long distance and is called from the !plugin.gz.missile.def.mk3 script which runs on each turret.

* The problem is that the InFiringRangeOfTurret script was meant to run on the turret and not the ship, so we don't have it here for use for manouvering. The ship doesn't know which task was for the main guns.
* so we can't get the TurretID of the main gun.
* Mordan3.

* The flaw here, is that the "follow object x with precision" command above will not bring large ships to within the range specified (even though the docs say otherwise), and larger ships are often sitting

* WELL out of turret range of the target. M6's seemed ok, but larger M7's just wouldn't get close enough. So, we setup a loop here to continually close the distance incrementally until the actual distance
* is within the laser range specified.
* Expanded 2.2 (from M4): Fire while closing.
* Mordan9 - fire while closing. Nothing below this loop runs until it exits, so
* without this the approach is silent however close the target already is.
* Mordan9 - and on the short leash above, 'follow object' almost always returns
* FLRET_TIMEOUT rather than TARGETREACHED, so the Fire! block further down (gated on
* FIREFREE/TARGETREACHED) no longer runs for any ship on this branch.
* This burst IS the fire path here, which makes $closeTimeout the rate of fire.
* Still not close enough, even though the follow object command indicates we should be. A failing of large ships in X3, and a result of not using Turret in-range commands anymore..
* anyway, if this happens, we attempt to shave off even more distance and try again.
* target is dead, so just bail.
* Make sure target has not moved out of system
* shave off more distance and attempt to get closer to target. Only do so if the follow object command above 'say's we're at the spot. Happens with large ships. See comment above.
* Not a station or a Huge ship so don't use station tactics.
* end, is in active sector
* Zero Hour Formations
* Zero Hour 1.5
* Add-Ons 1.7.4: Follower must be friendly with me if I want them to attack my target. Also, follower must not attack its own owner.
* For mercenary followers: must be working for the client, i.e. working for [THIS] ship.
* If the follower is not a merc, then we must check if the follower is friendly to [THIS] ship. Followers do not obey a leader who is hostile to them.
* Never tell our followers to attack our target if the target has the same owner as the follower.
* Fire!
* Mordan4 - Hoping this fixes issue where ship is jumping through a gate while lasers are firing on it, causing a lockup condition.
* This ensures target exists and in same system
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Require both visibility and laser range before firing.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Debug only.
* Mordan6. OOS delay lowered from 3 to 2 seconds here for faster resolution.
* We don't need a defensive move here (we already have a fallback check just before), it's just useless, we want the above to happen at all costs.
* Mordan6. OOS battles changed from 5:1 time dialation to a faster 3:1 dialation. Allows for faster resolution. 5 was just too much.
* Exit procedure.
* Add-Ons 2.0: Fixed timeout - added parentheses.
* If Fox 2, fire incoming missile if any. This is to simulate the heatseeker flag a little bit better than the engine does.
* Simulates the locking requirement.
* Mordan4 - If we're a support ship, check for extreme damage.
* ZH 1.7 fix - sometimes this script got stuck with the ships target being NULL
* This script could be called in loop if proper checks are not made before. For instance, the use of 'is in same sector as' command.
* Therefore it's best to change target than to exit. 3.15.
* Zero Hour: yeah, but certain enemies need to attack only very specific targets and the sector defense routine is too general for them
* Mordan9 - keep raider fleet from trying to defend a target sector. They need to fight and move on fast.
* if $target.owner == [Player]
* end
* Interrupt the fight if the target is no longer an enemy. Check also the exit procedure of this script, and !fight.defend.monitor.
* = [THIS]-> call script '!plugin.fightcommand.defmove' : timeout.total=10000 Object=$target intensity.input=null
* Also check shields.
* Only one fallback per fight (for low shields).
* Don't fallback if our chaser is faster than us.
* Safety.
* Bailing new system: we have fled, maybe we don't want to get back in the fight.
* Attacking manoeuvre: go higher than $target if we have enough room.
* Don't do fancy manoeuvres if the player is attacking the same target; save him instead.
* Ignore if we are attached to a carrier.
* do if $offset > 20000
* $offset = 20000
* Mordan8 - Try to get a little closer if firing missiles. This is for Non-Station and Non-HugeShip target scenario's.
* Don't want to always be firing missiles when at Max missile range as many will just miss, so get in to 80% range.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: X3's follow precision can leave ships outside actual laser range.
* Retry with a progressively smaller follow distance when the engine reports the target reached.
* Must not be docked.
* We are actually within firing range.
* Compensate only when X3 claims we reached the requested follow position.
* Do not let follow precision become zero or negative.
* Mordan, add back simplified OWP attack.
* Mordan4 - If a support ship, and heavily damaged, we need to exit the attack script, allowing the support task to dock us up for repairs.
* otherwise, we just keep attacking in a loop and die.
* do if [OWNER] == [PLAYER]
* write to logfile 1 append=[TRUE] printf: fmt='Support ship %s is exiting combat for repairs', [THIS], null, $ship, null, null
